sloka: अस्मिन्नेवंगते कार्ये सागरस्य ममैव च ।प्रीतिं प्रीतमनाः कर्तुं त्वमर्हसि महाकपे ॥५-१-१२९॥
transliteration: asminnevaṁgate kārye sāgarasya mamaiva ca ।prītiṁ prītamanāḥ kartuṁ tvamarhasi mahākape ॥5-1-129॥

translations.english: "O great monkey when I hold you so high, you ought to oblige me and the (god of the) ocean wholeheartedly (and accept our hospitalty).
